pure-announcement.rationale: It is a product README and feature tour rather than a launch, release-note or funding announcement, and it does contain one transferable idea in the meta-harness abstraction.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept covers an orchestration layer over multiple coding-agent harnesses; the closest are MCP protocol notes and the skills format.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Everything described is verifiable against the open-source repository and its documentation.

durability.rationale: The bulk is alpha-status product mechanics — installer extras lists, gateway base-URL tables, per-OS sandboxing caveats, upgrade and uninstall flows, a deploy-target menu — exactly the feature-matrix material that churns, with the durable meta-harness and layered-policy ideas stated only briefly.

actionability.rationale: Nearly every step is a product-only command for this tool (curl installer, omnigent claude, omni upgrade); the one design idea a reader could reuse, policies stacked at server, agent and session level, is presented as this product's config rather than portable guidance.

atomicity.rationale: Despite the sprawling feature tour, it is one idea — a common orchestration layer (meta-harness) over interchangeable coding-agent harnesses — stateable in a single paragraph.
